findings.evidence: Lines 125–131 contain the sole new theorem and its conclusion is only `IsPositiveDefinite G`; Mathlib `UniformApproximation.lean:120` provides `TendstoLocallyUniformly.continuous`, while roadmap lines 214–215 specifically identify locally uniform convergence as the extra hypothesis needed to retain continuity.
findings.fix: Add a theorem assuming `∃ᶠ i in l, Continuous (F i)` (or an appropriate eventual form) and concluding both `Continuous G` and `IsPositiveDefinite G`, using `hlim.continuous` and the existing positive-definite result; add the claimed family/sequential specializations.
findings.issue: `of_tendstoLocallyUniformly` concludes only `IsPositiveDefinite G` and has no eventual continuity hypothesis, so it does not establish the advertised preservation of continuity under locally uniform limits.

summary: The PR does not formalize its central continuity-preservation claim; it only restates positive-definite closure under the stronger locally uniform convergence hypothesis.
